$comment: Every content file the apps ship, where it comes from and under which license (SPEC 10). Paths are from the repository root; sources.test.ts fails if a file's SHA-256 changes. Published files are kept byte for byte; never edit them, replace them with a new download. Derived files name the script that builds them.
